data.description:
## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying all story done definitions:
- dd-1: /dso:test-quality-report is registered as a skill and discoverable via the available-skills list
- dd-2: Invoking /dso:test-quality-report calls calibration-report.sh monthly and quarterly and surfaces their outputs to the user
- dd-3: The skill's SKILL.md documents its trigger phrases and what each invocation produces

Create the skill directory and SKILL.md:
- Directory: plugins/dso/skills/test-quality-report/
- File: plugins/dso/skills/test-quality-report/SKILL.md

The SKILL.md must:
1. Open with the skill identity block (name: dso:test-quality-report, description: surfaces calibration program health)
2. Document trigger phrase: /dso:test-quality-report
3. Describe what the skill does: runs calibration-report.sh monthly and quarterly, surfaces both outputs
4. Include the two invocation commands:
     bash plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh monthly
     bash plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh quarterly
5. Document expected output for each (monthly/quarterly report format from calibration-report.sh --help)
6. State KEEP THIN: do not duplicate aggregation logic from calibration-report.sh

Per Rule 5 (behavioral testing standard): SKILL.md is an instruction file — structural tests only.

## Testing Mode
GREEN — instruction file only. No RED test needed. Structural verification: file exists, contains required sections.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Skill directory and SKILL.md exist — Verify: test -f plugins/dso/skills/test-quality-report/SKILL.md
- SKILL.md references calibration-report.sh monthly invocation — Verify: grep -q 'calibration-report.sh monthly' plugins/dso/skills/test-quality-report/SKILL.md
- SKILL.md references calibration-report.sh quarterly invocation — Verify: grep -q 'calibration-report.sh quarterly' plugins/dso/skills/test-quality-report/SKILL.md
- SKILL.md documents trigger phrase /dso:test-quality-report — Verify: grep -q 'test-quality-report' plugins/dso/skills/test-quality-report/SKILL.md
- SKILL.md has no duplicated aggregation logic (must reference calibration-report.sh, not re-implement) — Verify: ! grep -Eq 'detected_by|bugs_by_channel|mutation_rate' plugins/dso/skills/test-quality-report/SKILL.md

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/skills/test-quality-report/SKILL.md — Create
